improve.title: Forcing passes
tips: Below about 72% the extra passes start costing us. Pick the simple option until the touch comes back.
If nothing's on, keep it: shield, turn back, let the shape reset. Patience is a pass too.
Before the killer ball, check: is my runner onside, moving, and unmarked? Two out of three isn't enough.
improve.coach: This one's been sneaking up: 60% lately vs 44% overall.

improve.title: Defensive work rate
tips: Track your runner all the way into the box. Most goals against come from late, unmarked runs.
Second-ball awareness: after a header or clearance, be the first one to the loose ball.
Sprint back the first five yards. That's the moment counter-attacks are won or lost.
improve.coach: Down to 0% from 33%. The work is working.

improve.title: Passing accuracy
tips: Scan before the ball gets to you - a quick shoulder check means you already know the pass before you need it.
Count your touches. Two-touch is a habit that keeps your head up and the ball moving.
If you're pressed from behind, play it back the way you're facing. Don't turn into trouble.
improve.coach: 33% overall, down to 20% lately. You're fixing it.

strengths.title: Goal threat
strengths.coach: The goal was open and you walked right through the door. 50% consistency. Bankable.

strengths.title: Chance creation
strengths.coach: You're the opener on the team's toolbelt. 44% of your matches. Signature move.
